name: Kemnitz (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kemnitz (a white crane on blue above a mill wheel on white).
history: Arms and flag were approved together by the Ministry of the Interior on 23 May 2007 and registered as no. 313 in the roll of arms of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

features.role: Kemnitz arms — crane and mill wheel
